_comment: Drift that compare.php reports but does not fail on. Each entry names an endpoint and why its difference is not a port defect. Anything not listed here fails the build - that is the point of the file. Established by §5.47/§5.48; re-check an entry before extending it.
android-api-portal/app-user-register: Route whose controller action exists in neither tree (one of the six in api-contract.md). The legacy 500s on the missing controller; this application redirects to /. Both are broken, differently.
android-api/purchase-item: As above - BinduBundle:Api:apiPurchaseItem exists in neither tree.
android-api/sales-item: As above - BinduBundle:Api:apiSalesItem exists in neither tree.
flutter-api/poskeeper-instant-purchase-i: As above - ApiPoskeeper:instantPurchase exists in neither tree.
flutter-api/poskeeper-sales-update: As above - ApiPoskeeper:apiOnlineSalesUpdate exists in neither tree.
flutter-api/poskeeper-customer-create: Legacy-side schema drift, not a port difference: the scratch database carries this application's schema, so a column the port renamed fails on the legacy side only. The legacy error is InvalidFieldNameException.
flutter-api/poskeeper-online-sales: As above - InvalidFieldNameException on the legacy side, from the same schema caveat.

android-api-portal/apps.reason: Route whose controller action exists in neither tree: ApiPortalController::appsAction is named by the routing and declared nowhere. next/ answers 302 because check-routes.php repointed it at UnresolvableRouteController; terminalbd_api does not declare the route at all and answers 404, which is the correct answer for a path with no controller and the only one of the three that says so. The legacy also answers 302, so this is a wire change - recorded rather than hidden, and it affects an endpoint that has never been able to return data.

_targets: An entry may be a plain string, meaning it applies to every comparison, or an object with `targets` naming the ones it applies to. android-api-portal/apps drifts only when the API is the target: next/ and the legacy both answer 302 there, and only terminalbd_api answers 404.
